Read `AGENTS.md` and `v2/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` before editing. For UI work, `v2/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` is mandatory: preserve the approved Editorial University direction and reject dominant green, gradients, glassmorphism, excessive radii/shadows, side-stripe cards, repeated icon tiles, invented metrics, and filler copy. Render before/after when possible and state when pixels were unavailable. Work only in V2 unless explicitly asked. Always run/build from `v2`, never the legacy root. At session start check runtime and dependency freshness; use latest stable non-prerelease mutually compatible versions, read major migration notes, pin exact versions, regenerate the lockfile, test, and document upgrades. Preserve RLS, bounded queries, RPC consolidation, accessibility, responsive RTL, and secret isolation. Update `v2/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` in the same commit. Never modify or merge `main` without approval.
